# 1st Call UK Financial Services

> 1st Call UK Financial Services provides professional accounting, tax, and payroll advice from Nottingham. ACCA and AAT qualified advisers specialising in Xero, Making Tax Digital, VAT, and business advisory for UK clients.

This file provides an extended, AI-readable summary of the firm, its services, and common client questions. For a shorter index of key pages, see https://www.1stcalluk.financial/llms.txt.

## About the firm

1st Call UK Financial Services is a modern, digital-first accountancy practice based in Nottingham, Nottinghamshire, United Kingdom. The firm is part of the 1st Call UK Group and serves clients across the UK.

Key credentials:
- ACCA and AAT qualified accountants
- Xero certified partner
- Making Tax Digital (MTD) specialist
- Family-owned practice with transparent fixed-fee options
- Nottingham-based team with cloud and Teams meeting support

Contact:
- Website: https://www.1stcalluk.financial
- Phone: +44 115 845 3265
- Email: info@1stcalluk.com
- Address: The Old Coach House, 25 Noel Street, Forest Fields, Nottingham NG7 6AQ, United Kingdom

## Services

The firm advises on a wide range of accounting and tax matters, including:

- Bookkeeping and year-end accounts
- Tax planning and self-assessment
- VAT returns and compliance
- Payroll and employer obligations
- Making Tax Digital (MTD) readiness
- Xero and cloud accounting implementation
- HMRC investigations and enquiries
- Business startup and advisory support
- Inheritance tax planning
- Audit and assurance

Clients can request an initial consultation through the contact page.

## Frequently asked questions

### Why should I choose professional accountants and tax advisers in Nottingham?

Choosing local accountants and tax advisers in Nottingham like 1st Call UK ensures you have face-to-face support and deep knowledge of UK tax legislation. Professional advisers help you navigate complex HMRC requirements, ensuring that your business remains compliant while identifying legal opportunities to reduce your overall tax liability.

### What specific services do your accountants and tax advisers provide?

Our comprehensive suite of services includes statutory year-end accounts, proactive tax planning, VAT returns, and expert payroll management. We also specialize in digital transformations, helping clients set up and manage Xero cloud accounting for small businesses, contractors, and landlords.

### How do you support businesses with Making Tax Digital (MTD)?

We prioritize MTD readiness and guide clients through the process of moving from manual records to HMRC-compliant digital software. Our team handles the transition to Xero or other platforms and ensures quarterly submissions are handled seamlessly.

### Can your tax advisers help with HMRC investigations?

Yes. We act as professional representatives during HMRC enquiries, managing correspondence, preparing documentation, and protecting your interests throughout the investigation process.

### Do you offer fixed-fee packages for accounting services?

Yes. We offer clear, fixed-fee pricing so you can budget effectively without hidden costs, with ongoing advice and support throughout the financial year.

### How can I switch my accounting to 1st Call UK Financial Services?

Switching is simple. Our team handles contacting your previous accountant and transferring financial records, then reviews your position to optimize tax planning from day one.
